# Seasons

Used in [Special rules](/rules/90-special).

## Table

| Season | From | To |
|---|---|---|
| spring | Month: 3; Week: 3 | Month: 6; Week: 2 |
| summer | Month: 6; Week: 3 | Month: 9; Week: 2 |
| autumn | Month: 9; Week: 3 | Month: 12; Week: 2 |
| winter | Month: 12; Week: 3 | Month: 3; Week: 2 |

## Notes

- Roman numerals in the printed table are weeks of the month (Sept 1979 errata to 29.1, E-024)
- The printed Weather Table's season order is reversed; this table is the corrected sequence (errata to 29.61, E-025)
